question: With which of the following Indian states is the cultural festival of Bhagoriya associated?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Madhya Pradesh.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Bhagoriya Festival is mainly celebrated in the **western nimar** of Madhya Pradesh. 
 
• This is one of the oldest festivals greatly admired in the regions like **Jhabua, Dhar, Alirajpur, and Khargone**.
 
• The Bhagoriya festival is mainly celebrated by the **Bhil** tribe of Madhya Pradesh.
 
• The fair is celebrated **7 **days before **Holi **(Before harvesting the Crops) wherein people apply 'gulal' to each other and tap their feet dancing and singing to their traditional tribal tunes.
 
• It is a celebration of life and love which is celebrated with music, dance, and colors. During this time many fairs are held in the tribal areas of Madhya Pradesh and thousands of young men and young women attend these fairs in their traditional clothes.
